Feasibility test

The worm axis runs parallel to travel. The rack keeps the original module, pressure angle, compliant tooth walls and rounded reliefs at its center section. Its flanks curve through the 8 mm tooth width to follow the worm helix. The lower guide rail and four-insert output mount are retained.

Loading geometry checks…

Fine-mesh collision screening with OCC solid-intersection confirmation at sampled positions. The oversized tooth flanks intentionally overlap to create preload; elastic deformation, stiffness, torque, friction, wear and axial-bearing life are not simulated. Do not assume self-locking. The test fixture is larger than the production enclosure, and has no cover.
